day_summary: NVDA bounced cleanly on Juneteenth-eve, recovering from yesterday's FOMC-driven close of $204.65 to trade at ~$208 in pre-market and open near $208.53 — the first session back above the $205 June monthly options max pain level. The recovery was fueled by three converging forces: (1) June monthly options expire TODAY (moved from Juneteenth June 19 to today June 18), resetting dealer gamma and removing the short-gamma-below-$205 mechanic that amplified yesterday's FOMC dump; (2) the Iran ceasefire memorandum was digitally signed by both presidents June 17 and is in effect — the geopolitical risk premium is clearing from risk assets; (3) DXY at 100.23 and 10Y at 4.46% are elevated but stable, not accelerating. NVDA is recovering toward the 50-DMA confluence zone ($206.74–$207.41) — the zone that defined yesterday's ceiling. The conditional add framework remains SUSPENDED: VIX at 18.44 (above 17 gate) and DXY above 100 (regime trigger) mean no new longs until both normalize. This is the last US trading day before Juneteenth (June 19 federal holiday) — thin-tape conditions into the long weekend amplify any news flow. The NVDA Annual Meeting is confirmed for June 24 at 9 AM PT, the first post-FOMC management appearance.
